    A singleton background thread that samples odometry-relevant signals (CTRE Phoenix status signals and arbitrary DoubleSuppliers) at a fixed frequency, higher than the main robot loop, and hands out per-signal Queues of the sampled values plus a matching timestamp queue.
    RobotPose
    The robot's single source of truth for "where am I on the field".
    VisionFiltersCalculator
    A pluggable sanity check for vision measurements, injected into RobotPose to decide which camera results are trustworthy enough to correct the pose estimate with.
    VisionStrengthCalculator
    A pluggable per-axis trust ("Kalman strength") calculator for vision measurements, injected into RobotPose and passed on to NinjasPoseTracker.setVisionMeasurementStrength(edu.wpi.first.math.Matrix<edu.wpi.first.math.numbers.N3, edu.wpi.first.math.numbers.N1>) for measurements that pass the configured VisionFiltersCalculator.
